item.title: Macy Gray Returns to Australia for Most Expansive Tour of Region to Date
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our music update. We've got some exciting news for Macy Gray fans in Australia. The soulful singer is heading back down under for her most expansive tour of the region to date. Get ready for 'The Encore Tour: Back by Popular Demand'!"
[Short music clip of Macy Gray plays]
Host: "Kicking off on September 11th at Melbourne's Hamer Hall, the tour will make its way through South Australia, Victoria, New South Wales, Tasmania, Queensland, and Western Australia, wrapping up on October 24th at Ocean's Winery in Margaret River. That's 21 dates across metropolitan and regional cities."
[Short music clip of Macy Gray plays]
Host: "This tour is special for a few reasons. Not only will Macy be performing her hit songs, but she'll also be debuting tracks from her new album, 'The Trouble with the Truth'. And, she'll be visiting cities she's never been to before, including Shepparton, Albury, and Rockhampton. Pre-sale tickets are available from June 1st, and general sale opens on June 3rd via macygraylive.com.au."
[Short music clip of "I Try" plays]
Host: "Macy Gray broke onto the scene back in 1999 with the hit single 'I Try', which peaked at number 5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped the charts in Australia, Ireland, and New Zealand. She's since released 10 studio albums, won a Grammy, and sold over 25 million records worldwide."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Don't miss out on Macy Gray's 'The Encore Tour: Australia 2026'. Get your tickets now and get ready to party with the queen of soul. Check out the full list of tour dates on our website, and we'll catch you in the next episode."
